title: 1kg Coffee Beans from $22 Save 50% off Single Origins + Delivery ($0 VIC C&C/ $99 Order, Delayed Dispatch Op) @ Lime Blue Coffee
body:
Deal: 1kg Coffee Beans from $22 Save 50% off Single Origins + Delivery ($0 VIC C&C/ $99 Order, Delayed Dispatch Op) @ Lime Blue Coffee

[Wiadro] Wow do we need such a novel for some coffee beans?
[topherboi] As much as we need you to comment on every deal submitted.
[Wiadro] coffee beans at normal price.
/end of deal
[safwanc] Would you be able to extend your BFCM deal to your decaf beans?
[LimeBlueCoffee] Morning @safwanc never hurts to double check!
Our decaf is a Single Origin, so it's featured in this deal, so you should be all set :)
[tonydav] I'll give that Robusta blend a go for my d2d brew via a breville luxe. I'm a bit concerned about the level of caffeine as typically 3-4 cups of black each morning. Maybe I'll be able to use a lower dose. Anyways, worth a try vs my go to Aldi dark.
I like the sound of the Brazil São Paulo Single Origin for my weekend flat whites so a couple of kgs of that too.
[LimeBlueCoffee] Hey @tonydav how wonderful to hear, thank you so much for such an outstanding order!!!
Good thinking to perhaps drink a bit less on the days you have our Robusta Single Origin, it's the only one we offer, so everything else including our Brazil is Arabica so you should be able to have the normal amount you're comfortable drinking for the others. On Brazil is our of our hands down most popular Single Origins. If you enjoy our India then I think you'd also really enjoy our Peru Single Origin which is from an Arabica coffee tree :)
[SmashedMango] These Brazil beans are great! My go-to and highly recommend them
[LimeBlueCoffee] Amazing to hear @SmashedMango thank you so much for the wonderfully, uplifting vote of confidence!
I'm so wrapped to know how much you've been enjoying our Brazil Single Origin :)
[MattyD] OP It’s perfectly healthy to compete with yourself.
Just don’t beat yourself too hard.
[Joehax] Hey OP, any plans to stock India Baba Budangiri beans again? Was one of my favourites!
[Willyslicks] Best deal you can get in this environment
